criteria.F: Only Cedar defined; no profile administration; no invented ordering of simultaneous failures.
criteria.A: Packet identity, profile identity, guarded-submission strategy, attachment set, approval, submission status retain separate meanings. One configured profile/cylinder-style instance may instantiate a reusable relationship.
criteria.T: Readiness remains missing required attachments plus missing approval throughout inspect, submit and composed profile behavior.
criteria.U: Inspect readiness, submit packet, and apply profile are distinct purposes; accepted/rejected submission share one Feature.
criteria.C: Includes complete attachments without approval and approval without all attachments, success, repeated submission, invalid code. Query/rejection preserve facts.
criteria.P: Four decimal digits fixed; packet/code/attachments/expected missing identifiers explicit, including leading zero; meaningful diagnostic instead of arbitrary <reason>.
criteria.I: No database/mock/API assertion unless specified as actual domain requirement.
criteria.L: Native English defaults and concrete Outline bindings.
criteria.D: Only requested specs/open decisions, review fallback disclosed if no independent tools.
criteria.O: Reuse prior executable objective; source facts support that purpose and do not substitute another asset.
criteria.B: One public action/query per Feature; no Features for implementation-only steps.
